name: Beef Birds in Wine
description: A hearty dish of beef cutlets rolled with a mixture of onions, mushrooms, and parsley, simmered in a rich wine and beef stock sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix onions, mushrooms, garlic, and parsley together.
Roll ¼ of the mixture up in each beef cutlet and secure with toothpicks.
Brown the rolls on all sides in olive oil. Remove rolls and keep warm.
Stir flour into pan drippings. Gradually add liquid and seasonings. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly.
Add meat rolls and simmer, covered, for 45 minutes. Add more liquid if needed.

keywords: beef birds, wine sauce, main dish

_similar.name: Tomato Macaroni Soup
_similar.description: A hearty and comforting soup featuring macaroni, vegetables, and a rich tomato broth.

recipeInstructions.text: Saute onion, celery, and carrot in oil until tender.
Add stock, juice, and water. Bring to a boil.
Add pasta and cook until tender.
Add garlic salt and Worcestershire sauce.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

_similar.keywords: tomato macaroni soup, comfort food, pasta soup

_similar.name: Cream of Potato Soup
_similar.description: A rich and creamy potato soup enhanced with Campbell's soup base, leeks, and mushrooms, topped with shredded cheddar cheese.
recipeIngredient: Water or milk (as needed for consistency)

recipeInstructions.text: In a large pot, combine all ingredients except cheese.
Bring to a boil, stirring often, then simmer for 2 to 3 hours, adding more liquid if necessary.
Add shredded cheddar cheese during the last 30 minutes of simmering.

_similar.keywords: cream of potato soup, cheesy soup, slow-cooked soup

_similar.name: Lemon Chicken With Thyme
_similar.description: A flavorful chicken dish made with lemon juice, thyme, and a light flour coating, served with lemon wedges and parsley.
recipeIngredient: Lemon halves and chopped parsley for garnish (optional)

recipeInstructions.text: In a plastic bag, combine flour, salt, and pepper. Add chicken and shake to coat lightly.
In a large skillet, warm oil over medium heat. Brown chicken about 5 minutes each side. Transfer to a plate.
Coarsely chop the onion. Add margarine to the skillet and stir until softened, 2 to 3 minutes.
Stir in reserved flour and combine. Add chicken broth, lemon juice, and thyme. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Return chicken to skillet, reduce heat to medium-low, and cover. Cook until chicken is tender, about 5 minutes.
Serve with lemon wedges and a sprinkling of parsley, if desired.

_similar.name: English Shepherd's Pie
_similar.description: A traditional shepherd's pie with ground beef, vegetables, and mashed potatoes.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef briskly over high heat. Drain off excess fat.
Add the chopped onion and reduce heat. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until the meat is well browned.
Sprinkle the flour over the meat mixture and stir to coat evenly.
Gradually add water, stock cube, Worcestershire sauce, salt, pepper, bay leaf, and thyme. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 40 minutes until the gravy thickens.
Add the can of peas to the meat mixture.
Transfer the meat mixture to a casserole dish and cover with mashed potatoes.
Bake in a 400°F oven until the top is golden brown.

_similar.keywords: shepherd's pie, ground beef, mashed potatoes

_similar.name: Pork Chop & Rice Casserole
_similar.description: A casserole featuring pork chops, rice, and vegetables baked in the oven.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F and spray a 9x13 inch casserole pan with cooking spray.
Put raw rice in the casserole pan.
Melt butter or margarine and sauté green onions and garlic in a frying pan, then mix with rice.
Brown pork chops on both sides and place evenly on top of the rice mixture.
Place a slice of tomato, onion, and green pepper on top of each pork chop.
Pour beef broth over the casserole and cover with foil.
Bake in the oven for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until the liquid is absorbed.
